brief:
Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil has published a memoir titled "No Land to Stand On: Notes from Detention," Democracy Now! reported. The book documents Khalil's experiences in detention and his ongoing legal battles against deportation, alongside broader reflections on his activism and life as a Palestinian.

Khalil's account comes as he faces deportation proceedings while simultaneously engaged in legal action against Columbia University, where he had been involved in activism. The memoir serves as both personal testimony and political commentary on Palestinian struggles and the experiences of those detained in the course of their activism.
dek: We speak with Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil about his new memoir, No Land to Stand On: Notes from Detention .
title: Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil details detention, deportation fight in new memoir
